findings: The CSV was successfully processed and its event counts are internally consistent.
No rows were rejected as belonging to other processes; both configured game process names are represented.
Most retained entries are registry queries. Review found no custom game-vendor endpoint setting among retained entries.
Launcher ReadFile SUCCESS is present for root rumfus.ini and the updater temp.ini and wufilelist.ini.
Client ReadFile SUCCESS is present for GameGuard/RumFUS.ini, a distinct path from root rumfus.ini. This does not establish the contents or purpose of either file.
Launcher RumbleLauncher.ini and RumbleFighter.exe.Config observations are NAME NOT FOUND probes; they are not successful configuration reads.
The entry cap materially limits client-side conclusions. Absence in this truncated report does not establish that a setting is absent or a server address is hardcoded.

The public patch manifest identifies root rumfus.ini as a replaceable package payload. Static launcher code verifies generic file size and CRC32, making checksum verification a supported explanation for the launcher read. The sanitized trace lacks call stacks, so the exact runtime caller is unproven.
